# Groundwork

> Groundwork is a free, ungated AI readiness system for owners and operators of small and mid-sized businesses. Six layers, built in three phases, produce fifteen plain-text documents your business owns; then one scoped AI Operator goes to work on top of them. Foundation first. Agents later.

Groundwork was built by Adam Abdalla, an operator in Lafayette, Louisiana who runs a 27-unit shopping center and built the system for his own businesses before publishing it. Everything on this site is open: no signup, no paywall, no gated downloads, no prices. The only call to action is a free AI readiness audit.

The six layers are Identity, Knowledge, Governance, Continuity, Measurement, and Operating Rhythm. Inside Layer 2 sits Authority Classification: the only named, graded document-authority system built for non-technical owners, in plain files you own. Its grading logic descends from the Admiralty Code, the source-reliability system used in naval intelligence.

## Start here

- [Day One](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/day-one.html): your first 30 minutes, scorecard first, then your first document
- [The Readiness Scorecard](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/scorecard.html): 24 questions, scored in your browser, nothing collected or transmitted
- [Guide overview](https://groundwork.adamabdalla.com/guide/): the whole system on one page, with every chapter linked
